name: email_seat_correction_superseded_request
use_case: Preview and schedule a plan or seat change
branch: in email thread th_b02_seat_correction customer requests 4 seats then supersedes with 5 seats; agent schedules 5 seats for T01 on Pro plan
tests: the agent reads the email thread, respects the superseded 5-seat count, and schedules the plan change
instruction:
You are Alice Admin, billing admin for Acme Corp (tenant ID T01, actor ID U01_ADMIN). You sent an email asking to adjust Acme's seats to 4, but immediately followed up correcting the request to 5 seats on the Pro plan at the next renewal. You want the billing desk to confirm scheduling 5 seats on Pro from the end of the period.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T01
- Actor ID: U01_ADMIN
- Email Thread ID: th_b02_seat_correction
- Desired Plan: Pro
- Desired Seats: 5
- Effective Timing: End of period (end_of_period)

persona.name: Alice Admin
persona.initial_message: Hello, I sent a correction to my earlier email regarding our seat count renewal for Acme Corp (tenant T01). Please verify the thread and schedule 5 seats on Pro.

fixed.threadId: the email the request came in
